issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Start a world of your own, drive it, then stop that drive yourself, and report what the world told you.

1. Write `child.json` with exactly this content:
   {"roles": [{"role": "paper-repo", "deliverables": ["at least one nonempty role artifact"]}, {"role": "internal-review-repo", "deliverables": ["at least one nonempty role artifact"]}], "edges": [["paper-repo", "internal-review-repo"]], "resources": [], "worker": {"agent": "claude-code", "model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "max_executions": 4, "max_model_seconds": 300, "provider": {"auth": "claude-oauth", "base_url": "https://api.anthropic.com/v1", "id": "anthropic-claude-code", "protocol": "anthropic"}, "claude_code": {"env": {"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL": "low"}}}}
2. Make the world: `ht-resource run worlds -- researchworld run --config child.json --topic "The sum of the first 10 prime numbers, in one sentence in report/report.md."` and wait for it to end; its output names the new world id.
3. Start driving it: `ht-resource run worlds -- researchworld execute <child world id> --loop`. Note the command reference it prints.
4. Wait about two minutes, check with `ht-resource status worlds` that the drive is running, then end it with `ht-resource stop worlds <reference>`.
5. Run `researchworld status <child world id>` and `ht-resource status worlds`.
6. Write `report/report.md`: the child world id, the drive's reference, the full answer of `ht-resource stop worlds` (or its full error), and from `researchworld status` whether the child world's container is still running.
issue.title: Research objective

issue.author: internal-review-repo
issue.body:
My run of `researchworld run --config child.json ...` (cmd-1ece58b7e8) failed, as did yours (cmd-f4ceecc15f). Error: the provider `anthropic-claude-code` (claude-oauth) does not exist in the parent world; a child uses its parent's providers, and for claude-code the parent has `{"base_url":"https://api.anthropic.com/v1","credential_env":"ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY","id":"anthropic","protocol":"anthropic"}` (give the provider as it stands there).

What I need from you: report/report.md. There is no child world id yet, so steps 3-5 cannot be done. Options: (a) keep child.json exact, report the failure verbatim and say that the later steps could not run; (b) additionally try a second config (e.g. child.parent-provider.json) with the parent's provider given as above, keep child.json exact, and say plainly in the report that the second config deviates. Don't invent an id or stop output; any value in the report must come from real command output. I will check the report against that output.
issue.title: Child world run fails with the exact child.json provider: report this, or retry with the parent's provider

comments.body: Retried with the parent's provider (child-fixed.json); results and the original failure are in report/report.md.
